_comment: Ratchets for CI speed and reliability. Values may only go down: tests/unit/sdo/operator/test_ci_speed.py fails a timeout above this table, and the table is the one place to lower it. Raising a number needs the owner's explicit approval in review; prefer fixing the slow job. See docs/testing-guide.md#ci-budgets-and-ratchets.

slow_tests._comment: PR-tier tests allowed to exceed slow_test_seconds, with the reason. Go keys are '<package> <TopLevelTest>' (a subtest is covered by its parent); Python keys are pytest node ids without a parameter suffix. Keep this short: move the test to the integration/nightly tier (testing.Short skip or the nightly ignore list) instead of adding an entry.

go.sdo.dev/operator/memory/validate TestApp: compiles generated detector programs with real Go
go.sdo.dev/operator/memory/validate TestGat: compiles generated detector programs with real Go
go.sdo.dev/operator/memory/validate TestPre: compiles generated detector programs with real Go
go.sdo.dev/operator/builder TestEmptyCatalo: builds the controller binary in an isolated module
go.sdo.dev/operator/runtime/sim TestKubeCon: starts a real kube-apiserver and etcd
go.sdo.dev/operator/runtime TestRemotePrepa: compiles a remote preparation with real Go

python.tests/unit/benchmarks/sregym/fastloop/te: waits on the shared operator CLI build when it is the first test a worker runs (2.7 s locally, 13 s cold on a hosted runner)
go_integration: ingests and replays a 256 KiB reflection record through the real Go operator (17 s on a hosted runner)
